docs.text: pub fn validate_jwt(token: &str, key: &JwtKey) -> Result<Claims, AuthError>. Validates signature and exp claim of a JWT. Returns Claims on success.
pub struct JwtKey { kid: String, bytes: Vec<u8> }. HMAC signing key used by validate_jwt to verify token signatures.
pub struct Claims { sub: String, exp: u64, scope: Vec<String> }. Decoded JWT payload produced by validate_jwt after expiry check.
pub fn refresh_token(session: &Session, store: &mut SessionStore) -> Result<Token, AuthError>. Rotates refresh tokens after validating session expiry.
pub struct SessionStore { map: HashMap<String, Session> }. Persists sessions backing refresh_token rotation and lookup.
pub async fn login_handler(db: &Db, creds: Credentials) -> Response. Verifies password hash against stored credential and issues an access token.
pub fn hash_password(pw: &str) -> String. Argon2 hashing for credential storage; verified during login_handler authentication.
pub enum ConfigError { Missing, Parse }. Raised when config file loading or parsing fails.
def parse_requirements(path): Reads requirements.txt into a list of pinned package versions.
def migrate_db(conn): Applies pending schema migrations inside a single transaction with rollback on failure.
def retry_with_backoff(fn, attempts=5): Retries flaky HTTP requests with exponential backoff and jitter between attempts.
def render_invoice(order): Renders PDF invoice including tax breakdown and totals for the order.
